text:
[LEXP.4.1] Reserved identifiers; authors cannot bind them as variable or
slot names. Each is a row of [LLEX.9.6].

| Identifier | Value |
|---|---|
| `inf` | floating-point infinity (a permitted value) |
| `nan` | reserved; **not a usable value** — see [LEXP.4.2] |

The constants `pi`, `e` and `tau` are members of `math` ([LIMP.3.3.4]).
